content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":168,"severity":"major","message":"The change from `slice(lastIndex, protocolAtIndex)` to `slice(0, protocolAtIndex)` breaks the loop logic for handling multiple protocol-like patterns in the pathname. The `lastIndex` variable tracks the end of the previous protocol match, but the new code always slices from the start of the pathname, causing earlier portions to be re-processed and duplicated in the result on each iteration after the first. The `lastIndex` variable is still updated but no longer used for the slice start position."}]}
